witness.branch: Vehicle entry at signed school crossing
witness.quote: it shall be unlawful for the operator of any vehicle to drive into a crosswalk
witness.reason: The road and school-crosswalk control support an active vehicle-entry encounter once the sign and person conditions are established.
required_context: A displayed sign bearing exactly School-Xing, associated with this crosswalk; pavement words alone are insufficient evidence.
Actual marking or control arrangement, warning placement, route relationships and map support; children, warning activity and school-zone designation remain separate facts.
Applicable municipal jurisdiction and definition scope.
Crosswalk and roadway boundaries, approach direction, and synchronized vehicle entry and person presence.
Document crossing boundaries, markings, intersection geometry and school proximity. Preserve the engineer's unsafe-crossing opinion as external context.
Establish municipal applicability, operator identity, vehicle classification and any applicable definition scope.
Evidence concerning the person's attempt to cross and relationship to the vehicle's approaching side, without deciding those judgment meanings.
Preserve yellow paint or road buttons, approximately twelve feet, if necessary, conspicuous placement and not less than one hundred feet without inventing tolerances or judgment standards.

Provide a displayed sign bearing exactly School-Xing, its association with this crossing, display timing, curb placement and advance distance. Pavement words alone do not establish the prohibition's sign condition.
Synchronize vehicle footprint and entry with person position and independent evidence concerning an attempt to cross. Preserve the approaching-side phrase without imposing a geometric interpretation.
The protected person need not be a schoolchild; schoolchildren, school-zone designation and warning activity remain separate facts.
witness.subject_reason: The selected motor-vehicle driver can operate the vehicle approaching and entering the crossing; operator attribution must be documented.
